summary: A Bondi Beach practice open 8am to 8pm with on site 3D printing is a strength, but dead menu links and booking that leaves the page appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The Clinic Hours link appears to point to #, and General and Preventive Care and Orthodontics under Treatments appear to link to # as well.
findings.cost: Patients looking for hours or those treatments land nowhere.
findings.fix: Working pages for hours and every treatment.

findings.problem: The headings About Bondi Dental, On-Site 3D Dental Printing and Patient Parking appear with no text under them, and 'Pin It on Pinterest' appears as stray text.
findings.cost: Empty sections hide your strongest selling points and look unfinished.

findings.problem: The hero appears to offer only a free 10 minute consultation linking to a contact page, and online booking appears to exist only through an outside link.
findings.cost: Patients ready to book have to leave your site, and some will not return.
findings.fix: A booking calendar on your own page.

findings.problem: The email appears to be a free hotmail address, only one dentist appears named, and the claims 'no.1 choice' and 'best yet affordable' appear with no evidence.
findings.cost: A free email and unproven claims weaken a premium practice.
findings.fix: A business email, named team and real reviews.

redesign: A booking calendar and visible proof.
